      - ffmpeg:rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0#backchannel=0 # connect directly to main camera stream, no 2-way

    front_door_twoway_fullres:
      - rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0 # Connect to fullres
      - ffmpeg:rtsp://admin:4118nick@192.168.99.119:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0#audio=opus

mqtt:

cameras:
  front_door:
    enabled: true
    live:
      stream_name: front_door_fullres
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-aac
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/front_door
          roles:
            - detect
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/front_door_fullres?video&audio
          roles:
            - record
    detect:
      width: 640
      height: 480
      fps: 5
    snapshots:
      enabled: True
      required_zones:
        - porch
    record:
      enabled: True
     # events:
        # required_zones:
        #   - porch
    # rtmp:
    #   enabled: false
    motion:
      mask:
        - 519,480,640,480,640,480,640,480,640,90,640,0,518,0,525,276
        - 0,255,0,165,640,158,640,254
        - 0,236,640,230,640,0,0,0
    zones:
      porch:
        coordinates: 0,480,517,480,525,264,0,229
        objects:
        - person
  garage:
    enabled: true
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-aac
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/garage?video&audio
          roles:
            - detect
            - record
    detect:
      width: 1920
      height: 1080
      fps: 5
    snapshots:
      enabled: True
    record:
      enabled: True
     # events:
        # required_zones:
        #   - porch
    # rtmp:
    #   enabled: false
    motion:
      mask: 0.72,0.918,0.979,0.915,0.981,0.991,0.721,0.99
  back_door:
    enabled: true
    ffmpeg:
      output_args:
        record: preset-record-generic-audio-aac
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/back_door?video&audio
          roles:
            - detect
            - record
    detect:
      width: 1920
      height: 1080
      fps: 5
    snapshots:
      enabled: True
    record:
      enabled: True
detectors:
  cpu1:
    type: cpu
record:
  # Optional: Enable recording (default: shown below)
  enabled: True
  # Optional: Number of days to retain recordings regardless of events (default: shown below)
  # NOTE: This should be set to 0 and retention should be defined in events section below
  #       if you only want to retain recordings of events.
  # Optional: Event recording settings
  events:
    # Optional: Maximum length of time to retain video during long events. (default: shown below)
    # NOTE: If an object is being tracked for longer than this amount of time, the retained recordings
    #       will be the last x seconds of the event unless retain_days under record is > 0.
    #max_seconds: 300
    # Optional: Number of seconds before the event to include (default: shown below)
    pre_capture: 5
    # Optional: Number of seconds after the event to include (default: shown below)
    post_capture: 5
    # Optional: Objects to save recordings for. (default: all tracked objects)
    # Optional: Restrict recordings to objects that entered any of the listed zones (default: no required zones)
    # required_zones: []
    # Optional: Retention settings for recordings of events
    retain:
      # Required: Default retention days (default: shown below)
      default: 10
      # Optional: Per object retention days
      objects:
        person: 15

  relabel_configs:
    - target_label: "cluster"
      replacement: "TEST-KHC"
